question.question: what is road and when am i eligable for it

results.actual_answer: I see you've shifted from discussing leave policies to asking about 'road' and your eligibility for it. Great question! At AZADEA, "road" refers to the Remote Working Leave policy. This allows eligible back-office employees to work remotely instead of coming into the office in certain situations. You're eligible to apply for remote working leave if your job can be performed away from the office and you meet one of these criteria: You're ill or caring for a direct family member who is unwell You face an emergency travel situation outside your base country You're unable to attend or deliver online training from the office You're required to work during your annual leave Or, you have any other significant reason Eligible employees can work remotely for up to 30 cumulative days per year, as long as these conditions are met. This policy covers all back-office employees. If you need more details or want to review the official guidelines, you can refer to HRD - GEN - 016 - Remote Working - P - 2.md. If you’d like, I can also guide you through the application process or help answer any other questions you might have. 📊 Confidence: HIGH (95%) 📚 Sources: GEN - 016 - Remote Working - P - 2
